description:
Updates a screen scheme. Only screen schemes used in classic projects can be updated.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the screen scheme.
parameters.name: screenSchemeId

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["The name is used by another scheme."],"errors":{}}

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["Only Jira administrators can access screen schemes."],"errors":{}}

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the required permissions.

404.description: Returned if the screen scheme or a screen used as one of the screen types is not found.
